title: RSVP ERP dataset for authentication from Zhang et al 2025
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset of event-related potentials recorded during a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) face paradigm for EEG-based identity authentication. Fifteen healthy participants viewed sequences containing their own face (target) among AI-generated faces (non-targets) across four sessions spanning about 200 days. Recordings used 57 EEG channels sampled at 1000 Hz and are annotated with HED tags.
methods_description: Fifteen healthy right-handed participants completed four sessions over 200 days, each with 4 blocks of 8 sequences of 200 face images presented at a 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. EEG was recorded with a Neuracle Neusen system at 1000 Hz from 57 channels, referenced to CPz with ground at AFz. Target (self-face) and non-target (AI-generated face) events were analyzed with HDCA classification.
